candidate.source: current Very Easy LH notes only
candidate.selection: existing sparseLeftHandAnchors semantics: lowest note at first meaningful LH onset per source-measure window

collisionPolicy.safeInsert: retain anchor when resulting sounding count is <=2
collisionPolicy.defer: try an existing later Very Easy LH onset in the same window when it is legal; never retime
collisionPolicy.suppress: drop the anchor when no existing legal onset remains
collisionPolicy.rhPriority: RH baseline is immutable; never remove or replace RH to make room

eligibility.allowed: existing Very Easy LH structural/root/bass evidence
eligibility.excluded: drum-derived notes, decorative/arpeggio/repeated filler unless already selected as the existing sparse structural anchor
eligibility.case05: regression probe only; no special-case boundary or threshold

candidate.scope: scratch evaluator only; no production Beginner or other-level changes

metrics: active-source-window coverage and fully erased windows
notes, onsets, attack rate, median IOI
LH structural anchors and attacks per minute
RH+LH simultaneous attacks, max/median sounding simultaneity
hand alternations and percentage of onsets containing LH
pitched drum count and deterministic rerun

gates.rhParity: candidate Beginner RH event set must equal baseline Beginner RH event set exactly
gates.playability: maxSimultaneity <=2 and all existing Beginner validation checks pass
gates.identity: structural passage coverage improves without RH loss
gates.neighborSeparation: candidate remains below Very Easy and above Very Beginner on at least one complexity dimension
gates.promotion: one named outcome only; even a mechanical pass is a policy option, not a production change
